name: Kaysa
description: Moon-marked girl present at the casting; later Elder Druid of the Juniper Order.

description_citations.text: "World Spell". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fyndhorn is swallowed by the sea and refugees are led to Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: Fyndhorn was swallowed by the sea

citation.text: "Elf", section "Terisiaran Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Disa, Lucilde and Klazina take refuge from a storm at the village of Mikkel and find the church occupied by Halvor and Kaysa.
timeline.quote: the three reached the village church, where the priest Halvor Arenson and his protegee Kaysa were the only attendants

citation.text: "Disa", section "Feast of Kjeld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kolbjörn arrives to take Kaysa to Fyndhorn; Halvor objects, but Kolbjörn says the undead villagers will kill Halvor.
timeline.quote: When Kolbjörn announced that he had come to take Kaysa

citation.text: "Disa", section "Feast of Kjeld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The undead villagers break into the church; Kolbjörn and Kaysa chant the song of Freyalise, stripping the undead of life.
timeline.quote: With the magic of the goddess, all the undead were stripped of their unholy life, thus saving the group.

citation.text: "Disa", section "Feast of Kjeld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaysa goes with Kolbjörn to Fyndhorn with Halvor's consent, and Disa travels with them.
timeline.quote: Disa would travel with Kolbjörn and Kaysa to Fyndhorn.

citation.text: "Disa", section "Feast of Kjeld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise, Kristina, Taysir and others cast the World Spell, ending the Ice Age and the Shard.
timeline.quote: ended both the Ice Age and the time of the Shard

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise asks Kaysa to help cast her greatest spell, admitting she cannot guarantee the child's safety.
timeline.quote: Freyalise, revealing her blind eyes, admits that she can not.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Forever Silent the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise unleashes the World Spell, breaking the enchantments that caused the Ice Age.
timeline.quote: Taysir and Kristina witness the breaking of the enchantments that caused the Ice Age.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Forever Silent the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Klazina, Lucilde and Disa are caught in a storm and take refuge in Mikkel's church with Halvor and Kaysa.
timeline.quote: the three women were caught by a storm and forced to seek refuge in the village of Mikkel

citation.text: "Klazina Jansdotter", section "Feast of Kjeld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kolbjörn arrives to take Kaysa and says Halvor will be killed when the undead villagers attack.
timeline.quote: Kolbjörn announced that he had come to take Kaysa

citation.text: "Klazina Jansdotter", section "Feast of Kjeld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The knights fight the undead villagers; Kolbjörn and Kaysa's song of Freyalise destroys them.
timeline.quote: With the magic of the goddess, all the undead were stripped of their unholy life, thus saving the group.

citation.text: "Klazina Jansdotter", section "Feast of Kjeld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaysa leaves with Kolbjörn for Fyndhorn; Klazina notices Avram's corpse is missing.
timeline.quote: Klazina realized that Avram's corpse was not among the bodies.

citation.text: "Klazina Jansdotter", section "Feast of Kjeld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaysa speaks as Elder Druid but Yavimaya recognizes only its own voice.
timeline.quote: Kaysa speaks as the Elder Druid, but the Yavimaya recognizes only one voice: its own.

citation.text: Kaysa (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elves led by Kaysa and Jaeuhl escape to the Yavimaya forest.
timeline.quote: a convoy of Elves escape to the Yavimaya forest

citation.text: "Alliances (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Peace is made with the Yavimayan apes, the Elves settle, and Jaeuhl and Kaysa have a child.
timeline.quote: Jaeuhl and Kaysa have a child, and the Carthalion lineage continues

citation.text: "Alliances (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaya guides a group into Yavimaya, defends the elves, helps cleanse the Heart of Yavimaya and helps birth Kaysa and Jaeuhl's child.
timeline.quote: helped to birth Kaysa and Jaeuhl's child

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaysa sends Juniper Order druids to reclaim Yavimaya's borders from Heidar's second winter.
timeline.quote: Our border lands fall under the grip of Heidar's second winter.

citation.text: Into the North (Coldsnap, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A Gorilla Chieftain has Laina and Kaysa brought to him and allies his people with the elves against the Heart of Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: he allied his people with the elves , and aided in the attack against the Heart of Yavimaya , which cleansed the forest

citation.text: "Ape", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaeuhl Carthalion and Kaysa lead Fyndhorn survivors to Yavimaya and make peace with Multani.
timeline.quote: led the Fyndhorn survivors to Yavimaya

citation.text: "Flooding of Terisiare", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A great storm kept Mikkel's inhabitants from Krov; only Halvor and Kaysa reached the church for the Feast of Kjeld.
timeline.quote: Only Halvor and Kaysa reached the local church, intending to celebrate the feast anyway.

citation.text: "Halvor Arenson", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kolbjörn announced he had come to take Kaysa; Halvor refused.
timeline.quote: When Kolbjörn announced that he had come to take Kaysa, who bore the mark of the Elder Druid, with him

citation.text: "Halvor Arenson", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kolbjörn and Kaysa chanted the song of Freyalise, stripping the undead of their life and saving the group.
timeline.quote: With the magic of the goddess, all the undead were stripped of their unholy life, thus saving the group.

citation.text: "Halvor Arenson", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Halvor agreed to let Kaysa go to Fyndhorn with Kolbjörn.
timeline.quote: Halvor, admitting the miracle he witnessed the night before, agreed to let them go.

citation.text: "Halvor Arenson", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kolbjörn travelled to Mikkel to meet Kaysa and argued with Halvor Arenson over her fate.
timeline.quote: he traveled to Mikkel to meet ten-year-old Kaysa

citation.text: "Kolbjörn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kolbjörn and Kaysa chanted the song of Freyalise, stripping the undead of their unholy life and saving the group.
timeline.quote: With the magic of the goddess, all the undead were stripped of their unholy life, thus saving the group.

citation.text: "Kolbjörn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaysa left with Kolbjörn for Fyndhorn and was raised as the couple's adopted daughter.
timeline.quote: Kaysa was thereafter raised as the couple's adopted daughter.

citation.text: "Kolbjörn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A storm forces the three to shelter in Mikkel's church, where Halvor and Kaysa celebrate the Feast of Kjeld.
timeline.quote: forced to seek refuge in the village of Mikkel

citation.text: "Lucilde Fiksdotter", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kolbjörn arrives to take Kaysa to Fyndhorn and Halvor objects.
timeline.quote: Kolbjörn announced that he had come to take Kaysa

citation.text: "Lucilde Fiksdotter", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The undead villagers break in; the group fights, and Kolbjörn and Kaysa's song of Freyalise strips the undead of life.
timeline.quote: all the undead were stripped of their unholy life, thus saving the group

citation.text: "Lucilde Fiksdotter", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Halvor lets Kaysa go with Kolbjörn; Lucilde and Klazina bury the villagers and find Avram's corpse missing.
timeline.quote: Avram's corpse was not among the bodies

citation.text: "Lucilde Fiksdotter", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise places Jodah's mirror into the Ice Cauldron; Jodah disperses the energy over Terisiare, destroying the safe havens.
timeline.quote: would have caused equal devastation if Jodah had not dispersed it over the continent of Terisiare via the safe havens

citation.text: "World Spell", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the comic version, Kristina of the Woods gives Freyalise the idea to combine forces at the Summit of the Null Moon, using Kaysa's powers.
timeline.quote: Kristina of the Woods gave Freyalise the idea to combine forces to end the Shard and the Ice Age during the Summit of the Null Moon .

citation.text: "World Spell", section "ARMADA comic depiction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
